summary: LEIFRAS Co., Ltd., a Tokyo-based educational services foreign private issuer listed under file 001-42877, furnished a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026 covering the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing comprises unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements (Exhibit 99.1), management's discussion and analysis (99.2), an investor presentation (99.3), and a press release dated October 7, 2026 (99.4), signed by Representative Director and CEO Kiyotaka Ito. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural event is disclosed; this is a routine interim-results disclosure. Watch for follow-on capital-markets or strategic actions, but none are indicated here.
